what: A 14px white hotspot dot over a 3D scene, map or photo — its outer ring spreads from .55 → 1.55× every 2.4s while fading .9 → 0 (ease-out, endless), and on hover the dot grows to 1.28× (.18s). The look: link type (a dot that goes to another page) on hover grows instantly into a 36px circle, the ring hides, and the arrow inside rises from .65 → 1× (.16s opacity, .22s size).

options.look: If link, a 36px circle + arrow on hover (signals navigating to another page)
options.--fx-size: Dot diameter (via style), default 14px — the ring is twice that
options.--fx-dur: Length of one pulse (via style), default 2.4s
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: Arrow graphic (when look: link, sibling of the dot)

from.where: index.html .room__dots .dot (hotspot dots on objects in the 3D room, the phone booth uses look: link)
